prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one high fidelity 1920x1080 landscape game dialogue screen concept for Stone & Shadow, a C++ raylib first-person grid dungeon crawler.
Input images: reference image 1 is the actual current game screenshot /home/bison/Projects/blobber/docs/screenshots/innkeeper/innkeeper-front.png (UI style, composition, room materials and exact party sidebar). Reference image 2 is /home/bison/Projects/blobber/assets/npcs/innkeeper/reference/turnaround-v1.png (approved innkeeper identity only). These are style and identity references, not pixels that must be retained unchanged.
Primary request: show a dedicated close dialogue camera viewing the same friendly innkeeper IN THE WORLD, standing behind his wooden bar with pottery shelves behind him. Produce a polished but implementable mockup, not a cinematic portrait or an illustrated conversation background. Preserve the game's dark charcoal green panels, restrained thin antique gold borders, gold serif headings, clear pale cream body text and warmly painted low resolution dungeon world. Maintain the top Stone & Shadow title bar and existing four party cards down the right 380 pixels of screen. Keep Alden, Brunna, Merrin and Lethiel as the reference shows. No floating portrait of the innkeeper.
Layout: full 1920x1080 application view. Top bar y=6..45. Party sidebar x=1524..1908 y=52..1070. Main dialogue area x=12..1513 y=52..1070. Its upper world view y=52..690 shows a substantially closer camera at natural human eye height, framing the innkeeper from the waist up, his friendly grey bearded face around x=760 y=250, head and torso taking meaningful screen area. Counter occupies the bottom of this world view; shelves and plaster/timber remain visible behind him. Match his existing burly 50-60 year old body, receding grey brown hair, rolled cream sleeves, brown leather waistcoat, brown apron and warm welcoming expression. He is looking directly at the player. His sprite is visibly an in-world painted game character rendered against 3D furniture, not a photorealistic man. No new room layout, artificial blur or theatrical lighting. Foreground counter must not hide his shoulders/chest.
Bottom conversation UI y=700..1070 replaces the exploration toolbar and combat log. Two adjacent clean rectangular dark green panels: left response panel x=12..945, right topic panel x=957..1513. Strong readable typography and generous margins. The scene remains uncluttered, with no combat controls.
Left response panel: gold heading "INNKEEPER"; small muted subtitle "First meeting"; body text in cream, approximately 28px at full resolution, in three short paragraphs, exactly:
"New faces! Come in and warm yourselves."
"I keep the inn, and an ear to the talk that passes through it. If you're heading below, ask before you go. A little advice costs less than a funeral."
"Now, what can I do for you?"
At the bottom of left panel, small subtle helper "Click / Space: continue" and a clear separate compact gold outlined button "Skip introduction". Small page indicator "1 / 2". No typewriter partial text; display complete readable text.
Right topic panel: heading "ASK ABOUT"; below seven stacked compact numbered full-width rows with these exact labels:
"1   Trade"
"2   About yourself"
"3   The inn"
"4   The town"
"5   The dungeon"
"6   Rumours"
"7   Farewell"
The Trade row is highlighted with restrained gold border and slightly lighter brown-green fill, communicating directly selectable service during introduction. Each row is a readable button with comfortable spacing, no scroll bar needed. Tiny footer "Esc: leave". Topic list remains visible during speech, this is not a Continue-only cutscene.
Top bar text: left "STONE & SHADOW", middle "CONVERSATION", near right of main area "Sanctuary inn". Existing settings icons may be retained stylistically.
This is the first meeting state; do not add comparison panels, diagrams, annotations, design notes, implementation jargon, watermarks, decorative speech bubbles, new portraits, quest trackers, modern rounded cards or invented services. One single coherent full game screenshot mockup. Keep all text accurately spelled and high contrast. This layout is reusable for any friendly NPC; no inn-specific ornaments in the dialogue UI.
